result.summary: Page renders but has a major filter mismatch with Pizza selected while showing non-pizza restaurants, plus minor carousel clipping and inconsistent thumbnail sizing.

issues.description: Category filter 'Pizza' is selected but 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' show non-pizza venues like Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccolo and Tokumaru Ramen Bar
issues.suggestion: Ensure selecting a category filters the restaurant lists to matching cuisine or clear the selected state if filter is not applied

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' clipped at screen edge without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Add proper card spacing and text truncation with ellipsis so names do not appear cut off mid-letter

issues.description: Green Bowl Poké thumbnail illustration appears small and centered with large empty background while neighboring cards fill the image area, looking like an image fit or missing-image issue
issues.suggestion: Use consistent object-fit and sizing for carousel thumbnails so all images fill cards uniformly
